name: Boxes PRO OB Box
note: Author enters long (BUY box) when both a fast (21-bar) and slow (112-bar) Williams %R climb above -20 and hold there for a couple bars, treating sustained range-top strength as a confirmed 'box' signal.  SIMPLIFIED: Dropped the EMA smoothing (7-bar fast, 3-bar slow) applied to %R before the threshold check; conditions compare raw wpr; Collapsed the two-stage hysteresis (entry at -20, drop-out only below -35 after a grace period) into a flat 'above -20 for 2 bars' hold condition; Ignored the optional trend EMA filter and min-box-ATR-height filter since both are off by default; Only the long/ove
